<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_report = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_selected = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_count = []
missing_rate = []
kept = []

for indicator in indicator_columns:
    missing_count.append(df[indicator].isna().sum())
    missing_rate.append(df[indicator].isna().mean())
    kept.append(0 if missing_rate[0] > 0.30 else 1)

# Write the missingness report
report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_columns,
    'missing_count': missing_count,
    'missing_rate': missing_rate,
    'kept': kept
})

report.to_csv(output_report, index=False)

# Write the selected matrix (only indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30)
selected_df = df[df[indicator_columns].apply(lambda x: x.notna().sum() > 0)]
selected_df = selected_df[selected_df['missing_rate'] <= 0.30]

# Reorder columns to match the original order
selected_df = selected_df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + [col for col in selected_df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]]

selected_df.to_csv(output_selected, index=False)
</solution_file>
